options.name: account_id
options.description: Account Id of the tenant. May be used for modify or delete operation.

options.name: allow_compliance_mode
options.description: Whether a tenant can use compliance mode for object lock and retention. Requires storageGRID 11.9 or later.

options.name: allow_platform_services
options.description: Allows tenant to use platform services features such as CloudMirror.

options.name: allow_select_object_content
options.description: Allows tenant to use the S3 SelectObjectContent API to filter and retrieve object data.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the StorageGRID Admin Node REST API.

options.name: auth_token
options.description: The authorization token for the API request

options.name: description
options.description: Additional identifying information for the tenant account.

options.name: management
options.description: Whether the tenant can login to the StorageGRID tenant portal.

options.name: max_retention_days
options.description: The maximum retention period in days allowed for new objects in compliance or governance mode. Requires storageGRID 11.9 or later.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the tenant. Required for create or modify operation.

options.name: password
options.description: Root password for tenant account. Requires root privilege.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Object Storage protocol used by the tenancy. Required for create operation.

options.name: quota_size
options.description: Quota to apply to the tenant specified in I(quota_size_unit). If you intend to have no limits, assign C(0).

options.name: quota_size_unit
options.description: The unit used to interpret the size parameter.

options.name: root_access_group
options.description: Existing federated group to have initial Root Access permissions for the tenant. Must begin with C(federated-group/)

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified account should exist or not. Required for all operations.

options.name: update_password
options.description: Choose when to update the tenant password. When set to C(always), the tenant password will always be updated. When set to C(on_create) the tenant password will only be set upon a new user creation.

options.name: use_own_identity_source
options.description: Whether the tenant account should configure its own identity source.
